verdict.rationale: Undermind's own programmatic surface covers much of the UI. Its official MCP server exposes deep literature reviews, search with filters, bulk DOI/bibliography resolution, author lookup, full-text PDF Q&A, workspace notes, folders and starring, and the enterprise tier adds 'Programmatic queries via API' with batch processing. Parity with the UI is never claimed, and several UI features have no documented API or MCP equivalent: alerts and notifications, shared-workspace collaboration, team management, and custom tables. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the REST API appears to be enterprise-only. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, a public API reference or OpenAPI spec, programmatic access to alerts, team or collaboration management and custom tables, and independent hands-on confirmation of API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Programmatic queries via API ... Batch processing for high-volume research work
Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis.
Creates and edits Markdown notes, syntheses, and reports in the workspace.
Searches the global literature, papers already in the workspace, or a paper’s references and citations in seconds.
Curate papers into a folder for long-term use.
Star important papers across the workspace.
